description: A host's machine and its processes, sampled every few seconds while telemetry is on.

at.description: When, in seconds since the epoch.

load.description: The machine's load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes (null where it has none: a phone).

memory_used.description: Its memory in use, in bytes (macOS: Activity Monitor's Memory Used, app memory, wired and compressed; Linux and a phone: the total less what's available to start new work without swapping).

swap_total.description: Its swap, in bytes (macOS grows it as it's needed; a phone's is zram); 0 or null where it has none.

swap_used.description: Its swap in use, in bytes.

memory_pressure.description: How pressed for memory the system says it is: "normal", "warning" or "critical" (macOS's memory pressure level; a phone's low memory: critical, else normal); null where it has no level (Linux).

memory_stall.description: The share of the last 10 seconds, in percent, some task stalled waiting on memory (Linux's pressure stall information, some avg10); null where it has none.

procs.description: The host process, each app on its machine that told it telemetry (Baude, Record, the phone's app), and each Emission and Multiplex running there (the host finds those itself).
